safeReaderWording: A calendar visible in Cloud Calendars is not by itself proof that the same calendar is available in Apple Watch Calendar. First identify where the calendar is stored and whether the relevant event appears in Apple’s Calendar on the paired iPhone.
Use Apple’s documented Calendar and Watch settings for the system-calendar path. Treat them as Apple controls, not Cloud Calendars setup instructions.
Cloud Calendars Home Screen widgets and Lock Screen Live Activities are different experiences from a dedicated Watch app or watch-face complication. Do not infer one from the other.

Connecting Google directly in Cloud Calendars does not establish automatic Watch availability. The app can create EventKit calendar mirrors; their underlying source varies with the device, so check the actual calendar rather than assuming either universal visibility or universal absence.

An app-local calendar should not be assumed to be an iCloud or Google calendar. Verify a supported sharing/export/provider workflow separately instead of promising every app-local event appears on the watch.
avoid: Cloud Calendars definitely has no Apple Watch support in released1.7.3.
Install the Cloud Watch app or add its complication without authoritative released-feature evidence.
Cloud Live Activities cannot appear on Apple Watch through any OS feature.
Every calendar visible in Cloud appears automatically on Watch.
Direct Google calendars never create system-calendar copies.
Signing into Google in Cloud is the same as enabling Google Calendar in iPhone system settings.
Reset/unpair/delete calendars as a first troubleshooting step.
